excalidraw@afa3a653fc.notes: Feature commit. It matched on 'stale closure' in the message, which describes a memoized color picker fixed in action code; the touched CommandPalette effect only gained an extra function argument.

excalidraw@37ad85cbaf.fixShape: split canvas sizing into its own effect with deps
excalidraw@37ad85cbaf.notes: The static-canvas effect had no dependency array and reset canvas width/height on any render where its in-effect equality check failed (the check was unreliable, e.g. a fractional scaled size never equals the integer canvas.width), clearing the canvas and causing flicker. Sizing moved to a separate effect keyed on width, height, canvas and scale; the rule does not inspect effects without an array.

excalidraw@7bf4de5892.notes: Collaboration dialog redesign; it matched on a squashed 'remove unused useEffect' line.

excalidraw@933c6a2237.notes: Build fix replacing a lodash import; no hook change.

excalidraw@46f5ce5ce0.fixShape: fixed cleanup (replaceChildren before append and on cleanup)
excalidraw@46f5ce5ce0.notes: The chart-preview layout effect appended an SVG produced asynchronously and its cleanup removed `svg`, which was still undefined when cleanup ran before the promise resolved (as with dev Strict Mode double invocation), so cleanup threw and previews piled up. Deps were complete and nothing was flagged.

excalidraw@25d460be96.fixShape: moved DOM creation from render into useLayoutEffect with paired cleanup
excalidraw@25d460be96.notes: useBodyRoot created and appended a div to document.body inside a useState initializer (during render) and only removed it in an effect; the commit moves creation into a layout effect next to its cleanup. No symptom is stated; render-phase DOM writes can leak nodes when renders are discarded and fail without a DOM.

excalidraw@ba13f88924.fixShape: moved effect into a child component mounted only when the modal is open
excalidraw@ba13f88924.notes: The export-preview effect re-rendered the scene preview on every app state update (even mouse moves) while the modal was closed, because exportedElements changed each time. Biome only said modalIsShown was unnecessary; removing it would not stop the extra runs.

hono@224d2f5cbf.fixShape: added subscribe dep, read snapshot during render, useRef for latest getSnapshot, swap subscription at effect flush
hono@224d2f5cbf.notes: useSyncExternalStore subscribed once with [] deps, so a new subscribe function kept the old store's subscription and state, and getSnapshot changes were ignored. ESLint and Oxlint named subscribe and getSnapshot; adding them would resubscribe, but the fix also had to read the snapshot during render and avoid a gap with no subscription.

next.js@45d26dfd6c.fixShape: event queue that drains the backlog before enabling direct dispatch
next.js@45d26dfd6c.notes: The dev overlay's insertion effect exposed dispatch immediately but replayed queued events in a setTimeout, so events arriving in between overtook the backlog and hydration errors were reported out of order. Biome flagged the hook only for not listing dispatch.

next.js@ea541987d1.fixShape: wrap thrown value in error boundary state
next.js@ea541987d1.notes: Error boundaries treated a falsy thrown value as no error and re-rendered children, which could loop; a class component bug, not an effect.

next.js@0a2bdd7fbf.fixShape: reload on null history.state in popstate handler
next.js@0a2bdd7fbf.notes: The popstate handler (registered in an effect) ignored events with null state, leaving the router out of sync; handler logic, not effect behaviour or deps.

next.js@684c7c019f.notes: Refactor that replaces exhaustive-deps disable comments with useEffectEvent in three devtools hooks; no bug is described.

next.js@71f323d07b.notes: HMR hash cookie lacked path=/, so nested pages read stale cache entries; not a hook bug.

next.js@0b0e242821.fixShape: lint-driven cleanup: ref replaced by state callback ref, refs added to deps
next.js@0b0e242821.notes: Commit fixes exhaustive-deps violations flagged by the rule; the resizer now re-runs its observer effect when the element changes, but no bug or symptom is reported.

next.js@145d7613b6.fixShape: drive the effect from 'menu mounted' state instead of 'menu open' intent
next.js@145d7613b6.notes: useFocusTrap/useClickOutside ran when the menu was set to open but before the delayed-render menu mounted, so rootRef.current (and its ownerDocument) was null and the effect never re-ran once the ref was set. Label from the hook source at the parent (not in the worksheet data): the rule's warnings there were suppressed and named close/ownerDocument/onOpenFocus and the stable ref objects, none of which would re-run the effect.

next.js@01002efdc1.fixShape: depend on destructured primitives instead of the options object; local timers
next.js@01002efdc1.notes: Cleanup PR: the effect depended on the options object, which callers pass as a fresh literal, so it re-ran (clearing and restarting timers) on every render. The PR calls these nits and reports no symptom; the rule accepts an object dependency.

next.js@bc2964c41a.notes: The dev overlay ShadowPortal used useLayoutEffect, which logs an unactionable warning during server rendering on React 18.

next.js@bb3079ccf2.fixShape: prefetch from IntersectionObserver via callback ref (refactor)
next.js@bb3079ccf2.notes: Form prefetching unified with Link; the prefetch effect was replaced by a callback ref. Refactor/feature, matched on 'useEffect'.

next.js@785e9660d4.fixShape: skip the error-resolution effect for build errors (split component)
next.js@785e9660d4.notes: The overlay's error-resolution effect fetched stack frames for build errors too; each fetch made Turbopack rebuild and emit a new error, which re-ran the effect, looping forever. Deps were complete; the loop ran through the network and HMR, outside anything the rule sees.

next.js@2e9538bdea.fixShape: prefetch directly in IntersectionObserver callback (perf refactor)
next.js@2e9538bdea.notes: Removed an extra render (visibility state plus prefetch effect) on Link reveal; a performance refactor, not a bug fix.

next.js@fd0028e355.notes: Two dev overlays rendered when root tags were missing; a render-tree bug, not an effect bug.

next.js@2404b90eed.notes: localStorage access inside an effect threw when storage was blocked; an unhandled exception, not an effect-semantics or deps bug.

next.js@96a59344e8.fixShape: guard: announce only when the title actually changed
next.js@96a59344e8.notes: Turning on Strict Mode exposed that AppRouterAnnouncer's effect, run twice on mount, treated the second run as a navigation and announced the initial title. Biome flagged tree as unnecessary; following it would stop announcements on navigation.

next.js@03d6dcc08d.fixShape: moved debug global assignment from render into effects
next.js@03d6dcc08d.notes: Assignments to debug-only globals (window.nd, window.next.router) moved out of render into effects; hygiene with no reported bug.

next.js@02d020c459.notes: Server-action revalidation payload was not stored in the prefetch cache; router reducer bug.

next.js@48a50718ae.notes: pushState/replaceState ran in a passive effect after the new page had rendered, so back/forward scroll restoration and Safari's swipe-back snapshot captured the wrong page.

next.js@48948022c7.fixShape: add redirect boundary above root layout
next.js@48948022c7.notes: redirect() in the root layout bubbled to the error boundary; boundary placement, not effects.

next.js@a79d85d1a9.fixShape: store prefetched subtree in prefetch cache
next.js@a79d85d1a9.notes: Router reducer change for static page prefetches; matched on 'useEffect' in the description.

next.js@fa19c4410f.notes: New compat router export; the description contains a useEffect example.

next.js@65083f8faa.notes: Lets apps disable Strict Mode in the app directory.

next.js@42713fbf5f.notes: Makes the devtools reducer hook a noop on the server for dead-code elimination.

next.js@ed3cb83c8a.notes: Under Strict Mode/Offscreen the script-loading effect ran twice, attaching onLoad twice so it fired more than once; with `props` in its deps it also re-ran on every parent render. The rule accepted the deps.

next.js@f9706e0365.notes: Framed as a simplification, but adds a ref guard so the onReady effect body runs once per mount; before it, Strict Mode's re-run (or a new inline onReady each render) called onReady again for an already-loaded script.

next.js@e6862e4061.fixShape: mark remote script loaded only on its load event
next.js@e6862e4061.notes: loadScript marked a remote script as loaded before it had loaded; when Strict Mode re-ran the onReady effect it saw the cache entry and called onReady early, then again on load.

next.js@bf82a47393.fixShape: refactor: unobserve kept local to the effect
next.js@bf82a47393.notes: The commit says it neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature.

next.js@05b621aa9c.fixShape: refactor: portal node in state instead of ref + forceUpdate
next.js@05b621aa9c.notes: Refactor of Portal; no bug described.

next.js@0299f14a7e.notes: Adds param names to the router tree and drops a redundant replaceState effect and a console.log.

next.js@2f7951892e.fixShape: moved render-phase side effect into useEffect
next.js@2f7951892e.notes: The RSC root deleted its cache entry during render, so Strict Mode's second render missed the cache and rendered twice; the deletion moved into an effect.

next.js@468833e0b4.fixShape: compare with previously announced path in a ref
next.js@468833e0b4.notes: RouteAnnouncer skipped only its first effect run via a ref flag; Strict Mode's double invocation flipped the flag on the first run so the second announced the initial path.

next.js@c879fce0d4.fixShape: inline callback ref -> useRef + useEffect, ref for latest callback
next.js@c879fce0d4.notes: An inline callback ref re-ran handleLoading on every render, so onLoadingComplete fired repeatedly and looped if it set state. The fix runs it in an effect keyed on src/layout/placeholder and reads the latest callback from a ref.

next.js@1f5f0d313a.fixShape: record metrics from Root's layout effect
next.js@1f5f0d313a.notes: The new root API takes no render callback, so hydration metrics were never recorded; the fix runs callbacks from a layout effect. API change, not an effect bug.

trpc@028ad65e7d.fixShape: proxy reads latest value from ref
trpc@028ad65e7d.notes: useSubscription returned a tracked-props proxy over a snapshot; a prop not read in earlier renders did not trigger setState when it changed, so later reads returned the stale snapshot. A hook state bug the dependency rule cannot see.
